about-intro:
Front-End Developer specializing in Vue.js & Nuxt.js with proven experience building 15+ production applications — from complex admin dashboards to high-performance landing pages.
Mentors 150+ developers across two student organizations, creates technical content on YouTube, and contributes to open source.
about-tagline: Frontend Developer at neop — shipping 15+ production apps with Vue.js & Nuxt.js. Mentors 150+ devs, creates technical YouTube content, and builds open source tools.
process-intro: From a spark of an idea to a product in production. Four phases, zero guesswork.
process-1-description: I dig into your goals, your users and the problem behind the problem. Clear questions now save weeks later.
process-2-description: Wireframes and interaction concepts that turn requirements into a clear, intuitive flow before a single line of code.
process-3-description: Clean, typed and tested Vue & Nuxt code. Fast, accessible components built to scale with your product.
process-4-description: Deployment, monitoring and fine-tuning. I ship, measure and keep improving long after launch.
